mcpTools.name: cli_status
mcpTools.description: Read local CLI health and cached update status without contacting HolyCrab.

mcpTools.name: account_get
mcpTools.description: Check the current HolyCrab account and credit balance.

mcpTools.name: capabilities_list
mcpTools.description: List the public generation capability snapshot bundled with this release.

mcpTools.name: capability_get
mcpTools.description: Get limits for one public model.

mcpTools.name: generation_estimate
mcpTools.description: Estimate credit without creating a task.

mcpTools.name: generation_create
mcpTools.description: Create exactly one billable generation after explicit user confirmation. Supply one stable attemptId per confirmed draw and reuse it only when reconciling a retry.

attemptId.description: Client-generated stable ID for this one confirmed draw.

mcpTools.name: generation_get
mcpTools.description: Get one generation task by ID.

mcpTools.name: generation_list
mcpTools.description: List tasks for the current HolyCrab user.

mcpTools.name: generation_attempt_list
mcpTools.description: List local one-shot generation submission attempts.

mcpTools.name: generation_attempt_get
mcpTools.description: Get one local generation submission attempt.

mcpTools.name: real_human_authorization_start
mcpTools.description: Create one user-requested authorization. Show its private temporary link and QR image to the person for manual verification. Do not retry automatically or treat verification as consent to paid generation.

mcpTools.name: real_human_authorization_get
mcpTools.description: Query authorization status by ID. Poll this tool, do not recreate the session.

mcpTools.name: real_human_groups_list
mcpTools.description: List the current account's authorized people, with pagination.

mcpTools.name: real_human_group_rename
mcpTools.description: Rename one authorized person using the public group ID.

mcpTools.name: real_human_group_delete
mcpTools.description: Permanently delete an authorized person, every asset in the group, and upstream records. Set confirmed=true only after the user explicitly approves this exact deletion.

mcpTools.name: real_human_assets_list
mcpTools.description: List assets in one authorized person's group. Only ready assets can be used for generation.

mcpTools.name: real_human_asset_delete
mcpTools.description: Permanently delete one real-human asset from storage, upstream records, and the database. Set confirmed=true only after the user explicitly approves this exact deletion.

mcpTools.name: asset_get
mcpTools.description: Query one public asset ID. Only UPLOADED_TO_ARK yields ready=true; report failures and do not reupload automatically.

mcpTools.name: asset_upload_prepare
mcpTools.description: Inspect 1-10 local files and return a short-lived complete preview. This does not upload bytes.

mcpTools.name: asset_upload_execute
mcpTools.description: Execute one prepared upload plan only after the user confirms the complete target and file list.

examples.command: holycrab real-human groups rename GROUP_ID --name "新名称"
holycrab real-human assets delete ASSET_ID --group GROUP_ID
holycrab generate estimate --kind image    --json '{"prompt":"A tiny red crab reading beside a rainy window","model":"seedream-5-0-lite-260128","size":"2K"}'
holycrab generate create --kind image    --json '{"prompt":"A tiny red crab reading beside a rainy window","model":"seedream-5-0-lite-260128","size":"2K"}'

holycrab generate estimate --kind video    --json '{"model":"dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628","prompt":"A paper boat crosses a neon puddle","duration":8,"resolution":"720p","ratio":"16:9","videoTaskType":"reference"}'
holycrab generate estimate --kind video    --json '{"model":"MiniMax-H3","prompt":"Morning fog moves through a pine forest","duration":5,"resolution":"768P","ratio":"16:9"}'
holycrab generate estimate --kind audio    --json '{"textPrompt":"A calm narrator welcomes the listener.","audioConfig":{"format":"mp3","sample_rate":24000}}'
holycrab real-human assets delete ASSET_ID --group GROUP_ID
